notes.title: 1.2Version update: Water Fire God Battle
notes.content:
1. Added the Desolate God SP · Frostburn Blessing Rong, which can be obtained by drawing the Divine Subduing Stone or redeeming a code. It does not currently support self selection.

2. Open the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth chapters of the plot.

3. The SSR level wasteland god "Shengqing" has entered the SSR self selection pool and can be obtained through self selected props.

The promotion challenge activity has ended.

5. The event scene has added a "Ascending the Rank Bug Fix" event, where players with the profession of "Xin Hou" can fix bugs.

6. The SSR self selected gift package redemption code activity has ended.

7. Add the "SP Frost and Fire Blessing" redemption code activity.

8. Add the "SP Frost and Ashes Blessing" challenge activity.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148649/a04e7d324b3a477118d0d50b817852f6b29ccdda.png"]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update: Spirit Snake Offering Auspiciousness
notes.content:
1. Added SSR level wasteland god "Shengqing", which can be obtained by drawing the Divine Subduing Stone or redeeming a code, and currently does not support self selection.
2. Add an activity interface, move the redemption code function to the activity interface, and add a three round Spirit Snake Ascension Challenge to obtain top-notch rewards.
3. Adjusted the shield amount when using the Kuai'e style as an enemy.
4. Changed the combat background of the "Heavenly Maiden Salvation" chapter.
5. Fixed some known issues.
On the occasion of the Chinese New Year, we sincerely thank all players for their support. The game will release more and better content to give back to players. Wishing you a happy New Year!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148649/8e014582f858f22769a956099a63fe57781abf5e.png
